emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: danger tagging failure on TK-7102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on TK-7102, LT-7102 and PSV-7102 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on TK-7102, LT-7102 and PSV-7102 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically transferring hydrocarbon between vessels. TK-7102 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 18 January 2008 an incident occurred on TK-7102, LT-7102 and PSV-7102 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during a breakdown response, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
